title: mkwcat's NSMBW project
name: mkwcat-nsmbw.zip
description: Experimental New Super Mario Bros. Wii Riivolution feature pack.
requirements: Publisher documents real Wii and Dolphin; vWii-specific testing is not confirmed. Retail New Super Mario Bros. Wii disc and Riivolution required. The expanded8-player mode depends on4GameCube controllers, which is not a standard vWii peripheral setup; do not assume it works on Wii U.
setup: Extract the complete release ZIP to SD root and merge its riivolution folder. Enable Core (Required) in Riivolution. Disable other mod sections to avoid conflicts. Retain the original XML disc/region checks. Back up saves; disable this patch to undo. Review the publisher requirements before trying vWii.
